description: Introspection for the currently running LJE script.

functions.name: info
functions.description: Returns the parsed `info.toml` metadata for the currently executing script. See the [info.toml reference](../guides/info-toml) for what each field means.
functions.note: Resolves the *current* script, so it returns `nil` if there is no active script context (e.g. from a deferred callback).

returns.description: A table with `name`, `version`, `author` (strings) and `dependencies` (an array of `"author.name"` strings), or `nil` if there is no active script context.
